map.输入备考总时长及各学科难度或优先级权重，按比例分配每日或每周学习时长并生成可视化: Enter total study time and per-subject difficulty/priority weights to allocate daily or weekly study time proportionally and generate a visual plan, helping students schedule review across subjects.
map.权重分配：按科目权重拆分总时长。: Weight allocation: split total time by subject weight.
map.平均分配：各科均摊时间。: Even allocation: split time evenly across subjects.
map.薄弱优先：给弱项更高权重。: Weak-first: give weak areas higher weight.
map.：示例：总 10 小时、数学权重 3、英语 2、语文 1，则数学 5h、英语 3: : example: total 10 hours, math weight 3, English 2, Chinese 1; then math 5h, English 3.33h, Chinese 1.67h.
map.按掌握度与考试占比自行设定，弱项给高权重。: Set by mastery and exam weight yourself; give weak areas higher weight.
map.支持动态添加/删除科目并实时重算。: Supports dynamically adding/removing subjects with real-time recalculation.
map.本工具仅分配时长，具体任务需另行拆解。: This tool only allocates time; specific tasks need separate breakdown.
